notes:
ci: pin JDK 21 toolchain and run CI on Java 21

The Compose Desktop plugin defaulted desktopApp to a JetBrains Runtime
(vendor=JetBrains) JDK 21 toolchain, which CI could not download via foojay
(HTTP 400) on its JDK 17 runner. Pin a vendor-neutral jvmToolchain(21) so any
JDK 21 (JBR locally, Temurin on CI) satisfies it, and bump the CI workflow to
Java 21 to match the release build.
